translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: 1 Koriyn
book.title: 1 KORIYN Pol Minj Nind Ak Koriyn Biynimb Kuyip Tikak

content: Chin biynimb gunap kuyip wasemb ma ay, yikop kuyip minim yimb keykey aŋgniŋgambun akaŋ, enjol minim apay rek aŋgniŋgambun ak, tep ma giniŋgambun. Kun gon bel ak pikey pikey, biynimb gok timund pikniŋiy, kirpay rek nep ayniŋgamb. Pen biynimb wasemb ayniŋgambun ak tap yomb yimb.

Chin Gor biynimb nuk mindpun gok; gunap Gor minim aŋgep gok mindeniŋgambun, gunap gos tipaŋgiy key yimb niŋniŋgambun; gunap Gor nup gosimb niŋiy, yirik won gunap aŋgon key okok amniŋgamb. Pen ak minim yomb mer; ak yikop kun giniŋgambun. Tap yomb yimb mey; biynimb gok kuyip wasemb ayniŋgambun ak.

Pen tap chin maŋgiysek mindip rek, bilok biynimb tap ma mindip gok kuyip ñiniŋgambun akaŋ; Gor woŋg ak ginukniŋ, biynimb gunap chinup miluk niŋiy, mon yinimb namb ak diyokey kumniŋgambun ak; Gor nup tep giniŋgamb aŋgniŋgambun ak pen, wasemb ma ayniŋgambun rek, giniŋgambun kun ak tep ma giniŋgamb.

Pen biynimb Gor nup wasemb ay, biynimb gunap kuyip wasemb ay gipay gok, mind tep yimb gipay. Biynimb gok kuyip simb niŋiy mey, kuyip timey gey, kal ma jiwpay; biynimb gunap tap tep dey, kuyip miluk ma niŋbay; chin key biynimb yomb mindpun aŋgiy monmon ma gipay; kapkap mindrep yimb gipay. Tap tep gunap niŋiy mapin ma aypay; biynimb niŋiy miluk sek ma mindpay; kuyip timey gey, gos kun ak niŋyiŋg ma mindpay.
Miñ timey ar ak kuyip tep ma gip; Gor miñ ar ak kuyip tep gip.
Pen miker yerip yerip gunap kuyip apek, Gor nup ma kirpay; nup chiŋgiy mindpun ak, mindrep yimb giniŋgambun aŋgiy, tep gakniŋ nep mindpay.

Pen kisen Gor Kawnan chinup gos ñek minim nup aŋgñimbun ak; ma aŋgñiniŋgambun. Chinup gos ñek minim yimb keykey apun gok, ma aŋgniŋgambun. Day niŋbun miñ ak kunep, puŋgrikniŋgamb ak pen; wasemb aypun miñ ak, per yimb nep mindeniŋgamb.
Yenen: chin miñiy ar ar nep niŋiy aŋgñimbun; kisen ar ar niŋbun rek kirgiy, niŋrep yimb giy mindeniŋgambun.
Miñiy ñapan ŋaŋ gos niŋiy apay rek aŋgon wip; pen kisen biynimb yomb niŋiy apay rek aŋgyiŋg; ñapan ŋaŋ gos niŋiy apay rek ak kirginiŋgambun.
Miñiy ñiŋg kawnan paŋgniŋbay rek ak niŋbun: kisen ñin kun ak, Krays chinup niŋrep gip rek ak, nup niŋrep giniŋgambun.
Kun ak minim yomb omiŋal nokom mindip: Gor nup gosimb niŋep ak; nup gos sek kond mindep ak; wasemb ayep ak. Pen minim yomb yimb ak mey, wasemb ayep ak.
